basic_info.description: Welcome to 189 Margaret Ave - an exquisite sanctuary of modern comfort and breathtaking vistas. This magnificent 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence offers thoughtfully designed living spaces. The upper floor captivates with unobstructed city and bay views and an abundance of natural light that illuminates the well-planned layout. At its heart, a beautifully renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances inspires culinary creativity. The open-concept kitchen and living/dining areas flow seamlessly onto a deck, perfect for savoring the panoramic views. This level is completed by a newly renovated modern hall bath and two comfortable bedrooms. The middle floor houses the primary bedroom, a true retreat offering unmatched serenity and privacy, featuring a newly renovated bathroom and a private deck with a swing ideal for leisurely moments. On the lower floor, a versatile family room, equipped with A/C and heat, ensures year-round comfort. A renovated full bathroom adds convenience, while a walk-out deck leads to a manicured backyard, perfect for outdoor gatherings and relaxation. This home offers easy access to public transportation, including Balboa Park BART, Muni lines, and Ocean Avenue shops and restaurants, complemented by convenient freeway access, a commuter's dream.
